perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Under Pressure
enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Kickstart
enhanced.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideways
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Controlled Burst
enhanced.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Lone Wolf
enhanced.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideshot
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.
